short_summary: HealthRate is a SaaS platform that optimizes pricing for high-cost healthcare claims using AI and domain expertise.
long_summary: HealthRate.io is an award-winning SaaS platform designed to help payers and other at-risk entities save money on high-cost claims through price arbitrage. It uses proprietary AI, advanced actuarial expertise, and decades of data to identify cost-saving opportunities. The business model is a monthly subscription based on the number of lives supported. The CEO is Tim Michaels, who has extensive experience in healthcare.
